names: Nagoya TV Tower - Chubu Electric Power - Mirai Tower
mapIdentity.scope: The named OpenStreetMap envelope fixes center and orientation. Japan’s cultural heritage register gives the 35 m square steel span, 90 m observation deck and 178.7 m tip height. The operator gives the 100 m outdoor balcony.

note: Two exact CC0 Qualla photos dated 4 April 2011 control the steel silhouette, deck and antenna arrays. The structural case study controls the 15–26 m lower block, crossed reinforced concrete arches and 135 m transition to the antennas.
